```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Read data
# -----------------------------
set.seed(42)

df <- read.csv("/Users/siyingliu/Desktop/Heart_disease_statlog.csv")

# -----------------------------
# 2) Define variable types
# -----------------------------
numeric_vars <- c("age", "trestbps", "chol", "thalach", "oldpeak")
categorical_vars <- c("sex", "cp", "fbs", "restecg", "exang", "slope", "ca", "thal")

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  df[[v]] <- as.factor(df[[v]])
}

for (v in numeric_vars) {
  if (any(is.na(df[[v]]))) {
    df[[v]][is.na(df[[v]])] <- median(df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
for (v in categorical_vars) {
  if (any(is.na(df[[v]]))) {
    mode_val <- names(sort(table(df[[v]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    df[[v]][is.na(df[[v]])] <- mode_val
  }
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 3) Train/test split
# -----------------------------
n <- nrow(df)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.8 * n))
train_df <- df[train_idx, ]
test_df  <- df[-train_idx, ]
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 4) Build design matrices
# -----------------------------
x_train_raw <- model.matrix(target ~ ., data = train_df)[, -1]
x_test_raw  <- model.matrix(target ~ ., data = test_df)[, -1]
y_train <- train_df$target
y_test  <- test_df$target
```

```{r}
# Standardize using training set only
train_means <- apply(x_train_raw, 2, mean)
train_sds <- apply(x_train_raw, 2, sd)
train_sds[train_sds == 0] <- 1

x_train <- scale(x_train_raw, center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
x_test  <- scale(x_test_raw,  center = train_means, scale = train_sds)

# Helper: convert transformed names back to original feature names
get_original_feature <- function(name_vec) {
  sapply(name_vec, function(x) strsplit(x, "")[[1]][1], USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}

# Better mapping using prefix matching
orig_names <- c(numeric_vars, categorical_vars)
map_to_original <- function(feature_names, originals) {
  mapped <- sapply(feature_names, function(f) {
    hit <- originals[sapply(originals, function(o) startsWith(f, o))]
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(f)
    hit[which.max(nchar(hit))]
  })
  unique(mapped)
}

# Helper: fit logistic regression and return test accuracy/AUC
fit_eval_logistic <- function(xtr, ytr, xte, yte) {
  dat_tr <- data.frame(y = ytr, xtr)
  dat_te <- data.frame(xte)

  model <- glm(y ~ ., data = dat_tr, family = binomial())
  probs <- predict(model, newdata = dat_te, type = "response")
  preds <- ifelse(probs >= 0.5, 1, 0)
  acc <- mean(preds == yte)
  auc <- as.numeric(auc(yte, probs))
  list(model = model, accuracy = acc, auc = auc, probs = probs)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# METHOD 1: FILTER METHOD
# Correlation screening with p-values
# ============================================================
cat("\n================ FILTER METHOD: CORRELATION SCREENING ================\n")

# Compute absolute correlation and p-value for each transformed column
cor_results <- lapply(colnames(x_train), function(name) {
  test <- cor.test(x_train[, name], y_train)
  data.frame(
    feature = name,
    correlation = unname(test$estimate),
    abs_correlation = abs(unname(test$estimate)),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

cor_results <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results <- cor_results[order(-cor_results$abs_correlation), ]

# Keep top 20 transformed features
k_filter <- 20
top_filter_results <- cor_results[1:k_filter, ]
top_filter_features <- top_filter_results$feature
filter_original <- map_to_original(top_filter_features, orig_names)

cat("Top transformed features by absolute correlation:\n")
print(top_filter_results)

cat("\nSelected original features:\n")
print(filter_original)

filter_eval <- fit_eval_logistic(
  x_train[, top_filter_features, drop = FALSE], y_train,
  x_test[, top_filter_features, drop = FALSE], y_test
)

selected_features_p05 <- top_filter_results$feature[top_filter_results$p_value < 0.05]

filter_eval_p05 <- fit_eval_logistic(
  x_train[, selected_features_p05, drop = FALSE], y_train,
  x_test[, selected_features_p05, drop = FALSE], y_test
)

cat("Selected features:\n")
print(selected_features_p05)
cat(sprintf("Test accuracy: %.4f\n", filter_eval_p05$accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Test AUC: %.4f\n", filter_eval_p05$auc))
selected_original_p05 <- map_to_original(selected_features_p05, orig_names)
print(selected_original_p05)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# METHOD 2: EMBEDDED METHOD
# Logistic Lasso
# ============================================================
cat("\n================ EMBEDDED METHOD: LOGISTIC LASSO ================\n")

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 5,
  type.measure = "class"
)

best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
cat(sprintf("Chosen lambda (1se rule): %.6f\n", best_lambda))

lasso_fit <- glmnet(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  lambda = best_lambda
)

coef_mat <- coef(lasso_fit)
selected_lasso_transformed <- rownames(coef_mat)[which(coef_mat[, 1] != 0)]
selected_lasso_transformed <- setdiff(selected_lasso_transformed, "(Intercept)")
selected_lasso_original <- map_to_original(selected_lasso_transformed, orig_names)

cat("Selected transformed features:\n")
print(selected_lasso_transformed)
cat("\nSelected original features:\n")
print(selected_lasso_original)

lasso_probs <- as.numeric(predict(lasso_fit, newx = x_test, type = "response"))
lasso_preds <- ifelse(lasso_probs >= 0.5, 1, 0)
lasso_acc <- mean(lasso_preds == y_test)
lasso_auc <- as.numeric(auc(y_test, lasso_probs))

cat(sprintf("Lasso test accuracy: %.4f\n", lasso_acc))
cat(sprintf("Lasso test AUC: %.4f\n", lasso_auc))
coef_mat
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# METHOD 3: WRAPPER METHOD
# LOCO (Leave-One-Covariate-Out)
# ============================================================
cat("\n================ WRAPPER METHOD: LOCO ================\n")

# Full model
full_eval <- fit_eval_logistic(x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test)
full_auc <- full_eval$auc
full_acc <- full_eval$accuracy

cat(sprintf("Full model test accuracy: %.4f\n", full_acc))
cat(sprintf("Full model test AUC: %.4f\n", full_auc))

loco_results <- data.frame(
  feature = orig_names,
  auc_without = NA_real_,
  auc_drop = NA_real_,
  acc_without = NA_real_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(orig_names)) {
  feat <- orig_names[i]
  keep_cols <- colnames(x_train)[!startsWith(colnames(x_train), feat)]

  eval_i <- fit_eval_logistic(
    x_train[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE], y_train,
    x_test[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE], y_test
  )

  loco_results$auc_without[i] <- eval_i$auc
  loco_results$auc_drop[i] <- full_auc - eval_i$auc
  loco_results$acc_without[i] <- eval_i$accuracy
}

loco_results <- loco_results[order(-loco_results$auc_drop), ]
rownames(loco_results) <- NULL

# round only numeric columns
loco_results_rounded <- loco_results
num_cols <- sapply(loco_results_rounded, is.numeric)
loco_results_rounded[num_cols] <- round(loco_results_rounded[num_cols], 4)

cat("LOCO ranking (larger AUC drop = more important):\n")
print(loco_results_rounded)
selected_loco <- loco_results$feature[loco_results$auc_drop > 0]
print(selected_loco)
```
